limitations: The value is public and replayable/spoofable, not authentication. Root freshness and exact cardinality prevent accidental silent reuse in this bounded experiment, not malicious forgery or a mathematical collision guarantee.

Context headers cover navigation, assets and redirects as well as the POST. A matching value without exact origin/method/path is insufficient. Duplicate header lines may be coalesced by Headers or intermediaries; reject available duplicates/comma-joined invalid values and state the observation boundary.

Next may forward the header to inner self-fetches. An inner GET/action-result with the same value is not the POST; a repeated same-method/same-path forwarding/replay produces ambiguity. Do not label inner/self dispatch or parent-child causality from nonce equality.

A custom header changes the public HTTP input and may affect framework cache/header behavior. This is a separately selected diagnostic profile, not proof it is observationally identical to old headerless samples. No route/UI/native patch is proposed to hide such effects.
NetLog default stripping, circular eviction, missing header fields or proxy normalization may prevent the join. Do not enable sensitive capture modes or waive missing evidence.

No public nonce proves physical Store/realm/GC/resource identity, EOF, a missing-await fix, a unique cause, reliability or acceptance of any old failure. Original24/cache/stream/nonce/supplemental/strictbrowser gates stay separate and unchanged.
